title: Camera-Motion Compensation Is Not the Bottleneck: measurement code and data
description:
Measurement code, frozen detections manifests, per-sequence TrackEval output and figures for the paper Camera-Motion Compensation Is Not the Bottleneck: A Measurement Study of Shared Warps in Tracking-by-Detection.

The release includes 03_code/rac/verify_numbers.py, which parses the manuscript's own tables and confidence intervals and recomputes every printed value from the released CSVs and TrackEval summaries, exiting non-zero on any mismatch. 99_artifacts/RELEASE/REPRODUCE.md maps every table and figure in the paper to the command that regenerates it; MANIFEST.sha256 hashes every released file.

Benchmark images (MOT17, MOT20, UAVDT, KITTI), model weights and the third-party tracker and depth-model source trees are not redistributed; 99_artifacts/RELEASE/DATA.md records where to obtain each and the SHA-256 of every artefact that affects a number in the paper.

Code is MIT-licensed; the measurement data under 04_experiments/, 05_figures/ and 99_artifacts/RELEASE/ is CC BY 4.0.
